purpose: independent fresh-scene reimport check of the PEREGRINE delivery against docs/design/blender/peregrine/build-request.md
gun_local_frame: -Z forward, +Y up, +X right (game_x = x, game_y = z, game_z = -y)

top_level_node_names_exact.note: body, mag, bolt, trigger, factory-optic, extra + muzzle, grip, support, sight and nothing else

part_nodes_identity_transform.note: vertices baked into gun-local space: part nodes carry no transform

reimport_agrees_with_declared_translatio.note: Blender's importer must reproduce the file's own node translations

forward_most_vertex_z.note: forward-most vertex of the whole model

muzzle_face_centre_on_bore_axis.note: midpoint of the muzzle-face vertex extents

muzzle_radius_within_bore_radius.note: nothing on the muzzle may exceed the exposed bore radius

triangle_budget_10k_to_20k.note: triangles declared by the file; 19808 survive reimport

expected_triangle_count.note: 19808 survive reimport; the frozen delivered count, agreed by both files

primitive_budget_max_24.note: glTF draw primitives declared by the file

extra_three_mesh_children_direct.note: direct children of `extra`, no intermediate node

round_geometry_centred_on_origin.note: geometry in the round's own frame (placement lives on the node)

glb_single_embedded_buffer.expected: one embedded BIN chunk matching its byteLength

degenerate_triangles_in_source.note: sub-micron sliver triangles collapse to repeated indices once positions/normals/UVs are deduplicated.  The build owner classified these as accepted at freeze: invisible, ~0.9 kB of index buffer, and dropped by Blender's mesh validation on import.  Measured and reported, not counted against the delivery.

reimport_reproduces_declared_triangles.note: a strict reimport reproduces every triangle; the shortfall is exactly the degenerate triangles above, which Blender's mesh validation drops
